notes.title: War Untold is out now in Early Access!
notes.content: [p]We will be publishing updates and hotfixes over the coming weeks to address any concerns/bugs. Currently, our top priorities are AI decision making, unit balance, terrain system improvements, and new maps.[/p][p][/p][p]Head on over to the Discord to keep in touch with the community, and submit your own feedback/bug reports![/p][p][/p][p]Good luck commanders![/p]
